detection_gate: signal > width, signal = d_null - d_self, width = 95% spread of d_self across splits
competition_gate: separation > spread, spread = 95% spread of the nearest-competitor separation across the same splits
note: R = d_self / d_null is reported but is not a gate. replicate_ceiling, p_correct_order and p_correct_winner must not be joined to results/canonical/resolution_sweep.csv; see the module docstring.
